snippet.title: Super Mario 63: 100% Complete Long Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Super Mario 63: 100% Complete Long Walkthrough

Click To Subscribe for More Content Like This!!!!
https://www.youtube.com/user/JhonGaming

Super Mario 63 is a fan-game inspired by Nintendo's Super Mario 64. Many levels and features are based upon it and other of Nintendo's games, but a variety of them are completely original. Among them include a detailed storyline, ability to play as Luigi, a highly customization Level Designer with shareable codes, three different FLUDD Power-ups, four different power-caps, and 64 Shine Sprites & 64 Star Coins to collect.

You can play this game yourself, play it here on Newgrounds. Link Below👇👇👇
